h2: Mercedes C-Class|**OM651** Timing Chain|& **M156 AMG** Issues?
description: The OM651 diesel is widely documented for injector seal leaks and timing chain/tensioner wear, backed by multiple TSBs. Pre-2012 M156 V8 C63 AMGs share a separately established camshaft adjuster and head bolt pattern.

callout.title: A Well-Documented Issue
callout.body: OM651 injector seal leaks and timing chain wear are widely documented across Mercedes specialist forums and official TSBs.

heroHook.title: Include In Hero Hook:
heroHook.body: Yes — both verified: OM651 widely documented with multiple TSBs; M156 pre-2012 established AMG specialist pattern.

features.title: New Timing Chains
features.body: Replaced as standard (where worn or damaged)

features.title: Peace Of Mind
features.body: No hidden extras — just a stronger, longer-lasting engine
